label: suspect

unstated.what: An empty resolved definition (Fn::Join with an empty parts list yielding an empty string) must produce no errors at all, rather than 'StartAt'/'States' required-property errors from parsing an empty string

instruction_covers: Resolving intrinsic functions (Fn::Join, etc.) in AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine DefinitionString before schema validation so E1022/E3601 are not raised for  templates constructing the definition with intrinsic functions
reason: The instruction's sample template only requires non-empty Fn::Join strings to resolve correctly; the hidden test additionally requires that an Fn::Join resolving to an empty string yields zero errors, which is a behavior choice (skip validation on empty definition) not stated but a natural one an engineer would likely make.
